dataset_name: Physical Object Dictionary for Camera Scanner
purpose: Dictionary metadata for a face/object scanner. The JSON stores labels and descriptive information; it does not itself train an object-detection model.
important_note: For recognition, each scan_label still requires a suitable trained model/class and representative images. 5,000 labels are too many to train well from only a few images per class.

entries.description: Chair is a physical object or item primarily associated with furnishing. It is included in this dataset because it has a visible form that can be photographed and used as a label in an image-classification or object-recognition system.
entries.primary_use: Commonly used for furnishing.
entries.common_locations: homes, offices, schools, hotels, or other indoor spaces
entries.visual_identification: Identify it using features such as shape, legs or support structure, surfaces, cushions, handles, and proportions. Exact appearance can vary by brand, size, material, color, and model.
materials: Fabric or plastic depending on design

recommended_images.capture_notes: Keep the target object clearly visible, vary lighting/background/distance, and avoid using only near-duplicate photos.
